diagrams.title: “Write a blog post” sounds trivial until you draw it
diagrams.caption: “Write a blog post” sounds trivial until you draw it. Run the research agent 40 times and you get 40 different source sets, yet the article has to come out factually right every time. Long drafts are full of mistakes, so the writer has to find them, fix them, and decide when to stop.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 980 330" aria-label="Preview architecture of the blog-writing multi-agent system. Sources such as web pages, GitHub repos, YouTube videos and local files feed a research agent that loops search, evaluate and refine in a ReAct pattern, then writes research.md. A writer agent built with LangGraph takes the research, a voice profile, style rule books and past articles, and loops draft, review and fix with checkpoints until no issues remain, producing the article. Underneath both run memory, observability and delivery layers." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

diagrams.title: The model sits at the two ends, reading language in and writing language out
diagrams.caption: The model sits at the two ends, reading language in and writing language out. Everything in the middle, where money and approval are decided, is plain Python with constants a reviewer can read.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 980 306" aria-label="Pipeline. The report text goes to classify_chain, an LLM call, which returns a category. Code routes the category to one of three calculators, or to zero dollars for unknown. Code compares the amount with the tier threshold. If over the threshold or unknown, escalate_chain writes a manager note; otherwise draft_email_chain writes a customer email. The result dict is recorded into the daily log, which feeds the daily summary." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs><marker id="a8" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="currentColor"></path></marker></defs>
